item.title: A $3 million Ontario home comes with a perfect view of the slopes
item.description: If your winter travel plans now involve less TSA, more après-ski, this house understood the assignment.Perched in the Blue Mountains with front-row seats to Blue Mountain Ski Resort, this fully furnished custom home is basically what happens when a five-star chalet and a luxury home have a very successful Canadian baby.And honestly? The timing couldn't be more on the nose. With more Canadians choosing to winter in Canada instead of fleeing south, a place like this is the perfect at-home getaway.

item.title: Toronto food stall was a home away from home for 25 years and now it's gone
item.description: After 25 years, the last-standing food stall at Toronto's Cumberland Terrace has closed its doors, closing a chapter of turning soup into a home away from home.Esther Joseph explains that, when she first moved to Toronto from Colombo, Sri Lanka, fleeing the civil war in 1995, two things struck her immediately: it was near-impossible to find a job, and it was cold.
